requirements.text: Focused verification may reuse only a digest-valid full baseline whose candidate identity is explicit; missing, stale, partial, or untrusted baselines must fail closed or cause the affected checks to run.

A full run must have a structured admission decision so an exact already-verified candidate can be reused while changed candidates, runner changes, or missing prerequisites cannot silently reuse old evidence.

Projects can declare suite inclusion as data; transitive inclusion is resolved once, cycles and unknown references are rejected, and an included suite is not executed twice for the same candidate and test manifest.

Candidate identity changes invalidate prior approval and verification evidence; reviewer policy defaults to evidence audit plus independent risk probes and requests a full rebuild only for explicit trust or runner risks.

A requirement document or structured spec containing configured placeholder text in required fields cannot enter a configured completed state, while valid completed documents and non-completed drafts remain allowed.
All public defaults and documentation remain project-neutral and expose policy primitives rather than embedding an adopter-specific controller or command name.

design.summary: Add a reusable verification-policy module, connect trusted-baseline reuse and suite de-duplication to SHK verify, enforce requirement completeness at task completion, and update public verification/reviewer guidance.

risk_points.text: A forged or partial baseline could suppress a required check.
Suite inclusion cycles or ambiguous ownership could skip every runnable suite or double-count inherited success.
Candidate rewrite could leave old review or full evidence looking current.
Placeholder detection could either miss common placeholders or reject legitimate prose and permanently block completion.
Changing default verify semantics could unexpectedly break existing adopters.

traffic_flows.name: focused verification from trusted baseline
steps: load and authenticate configured baseline evidence
compare baseline identity to current candidate
run affected checks and record reasons

traffic_flows.name: suite planning
steps: drop suites already covered by another selected suite
project the containing suite verdict onto included suites with provenance

traffic_flows.name: candidate and reviewer admission
steps: choose evidence audit plus risk probes or full rebuild

traffic_flows.name: requirement completion
steps: inspect structured values or document sections
reject completed state with incomplete required content
allow valid completion and draft states

test_plan.scenario: admission and continuity distinguish exact trusted evidence from missing, stale, rewritten, partial, or runner-sensitive evidence
assertions: exact trusted full evidence is reusable
candidate or manifest changes invalidate reuse

test_plan.scenario: declarative suite graphs de-duplicate direct and transitive inclusion without hiding invalid graphs
assertions: cycles and unknown suites fail closed
failed containing suite cannot yield inherited PASS

test_plan.scenario: completion rejects placeholders only in configured required content and permits complete or non-completed controls
assertions: TODO/TBD and configured localized placeholders fail
ordinary words containing similar substrings do not false-positive
task close fails before mutating task state

test_plan.scenario: a temporary Git project exercises focused baseline reuse, suite de-duplication, candidate rewrite invalidation, reviewer policy, and completion blocking through public SHK entrypoints
assertions: negative mutations return non-zero with reason codes
public files contain no adopter-specific vocabulary
